comments: Listed in [HMSTSJ7Q]: 55 (mnga' ris khul gyi dpe rnying gnas stangs kyi brtag dpyad snyan zhu, spu hrengs khul, 'khor chags dgon), No. 2: bslab pa kun las btus pa'i Tik+ka | slob dpon phya pa'i slob ma mkhas mchog 'jad pa ston skyabs kyi mdzad pa | mchan la dpal chos kyi 'od zer gyi dpe yin zhes 'khod pa'i pod gcig | mda' tshad ma | 'di dpe dkon yin |.
